# Computer Science Program

![Computer Science Program](/sites/default/files/styles/actualite_full/public/pages/images/2020-09/Computer%20science.jpg?h=2acb40e2&itok=gXSFRfua)

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Master | 2 Years - 120 ECTS |
| Course Start | September |
| Language | English |
| Location | Palaiseau Campus |

## Description

The Master of Computer Science is a two-year program designed for students interested in algorithms, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, human-computer interaction, networks, and systems. This selective program draws on IP Paris’s cutting-edge research laboratories and world-class researchers.

This program has a strong focus on research. The first year provides a solid foundation in key areas, while the second year offers the opportunity to specialize in one of several fields.

For students aiming to pursue a PhD after their master’s degree, the program is affiliated with three PhD track programs for early research immersion: one in Computer Science, another in Data & Artificial Intelligence, and one in Quantum Computing (within the PhD Track Quantum Science and Technologies). These PhD track programs offer excellence scholarships and registration fee waivers.

## Tracks

1. **Foundations of computer science, Operations research, Distributed computing, and Quantum computing (FODQ)**

This track focuses on the core components of Computer Science, ranging from theory and mathematics to applied distributed systems and quantum computing. Students have to choose one of the following 2-year majors:

* [Foundations of Computer Science (MPRI)](/en/education/institut-polytechnique-de-paris-masters/computer-science-program/master-year-2-foundations-computer-science)
* [Operational Research (MPRO)](/en/education/institut-polytechnique-de-paris-masters/computer-science-program/master-2-recherche-operationnelle)
* [Parallel and Distributed Systems (PDS)](https://www.ip-paris.fr/en/education/masters/computer-science-program/master-year-2-parallel-and-distributed-systems)
* [Quantum, Mathematics, Computer Science (QMI)](/en/education/masters/computer-science-program/master-year-2-quantum-mathematics-computer-science)

1. **Cybersecurity, Cyberphysical Systems, and Networks (CCSN)**

This track addresses the main components of nowadays IT systems. It equips students with advanced technical skills and theoretical knowledge in securing digital infrastructures,formally designing and verifying intelligent cyber-physical systems, and optimizing modern network architectures. Students have to choose one of the following 2-year majors:

* [Computer Science for Networks (CSN)](/en/education/institut-polytechnique-de-paris-masters/computer-science-program/master-year-2-computer-science-networks)
* [Cyber-Physical Systems (CPS)](/en/education/institut-polytechnique-de-paris-masters/computer-science-program/master-year-2-cyber-physical-systems)
* [Cybersecurity (Cyber)](https://www.ip-paris.fr/en/education/masters/computer-science-program/master-year-2-cybersecurity)

1. **Data, Artificial Intelligence, and Graphics (DAIIG)**

This track focuses on extracting information from data, and managing interactions with humans. These majors provide a balanced skill set, combining analytical rigor with creative problem-solving, for careers in AI research, data engineering, UX/UI design, or interactive media. Students have to choose one of the following 2-year majors:

* [Data and Artificial Intelligence (DataAI)](/en/education/masters/computer-science-program/master-year-2-data-and-artificial-intelligence)
* [Interaction, Graphics and Design (IGD)](/en/education/institut-polytechnique-de-paris-masters/computer-science-program/master-year-2-interaction-graphics-design)

### PhD tracks

* [Computer Science](/en/education/phd-track/computer-science)
* [Data & Artificial Intelligence](/en/education/phd-track/data-artificial-intelligence)
* [Quantum Science and Technologies (QUANTIX)](/en/education/phd-track/phd-track-quantum-science-and-technologies-quantix)

## Objectives

This master's degree aims to enable students to:

* Master fundamental knowledge and tools in computer science before specialization;
* Master recent advanced research in various related domains;
* Apply scientific knowledge and concepts in original and personal research projects.

## General admission prerequisites

#### Academic prerequisites

* Bachelor of Science in Computer Science

#### Language prerequisites

* English (B2)

#### How to apply

Applications can be submitted exclusively online. You will need to provide the following documents:

* Transcript
* Two academic references (added online directly by your referees)
* CV/resume
* Statement of purpose highlighting your research interests and motivation for research

### Fees and scholarships

[Registration fees are available here](https://www.ip-paris.fr/en/education/masters/faqs)

[Find out more about scholarships](/education/bourses)

Please note that fees and scholarships may change for the following year.

## Applications and admission dates

[Admissions page](/en/education/admissions)

## Career opportunities

Upon completing the second year of the Master’s program, graduates will be well-equipped to pursue a PhD. They may also explore a wide range of career opportunities in academic or industrial research laboratories.

## Contact

# Admissions

![Admissions](/sites/default/files/styles/actualite_full/public/pages/images/2026-01/Cover%20page%20admission%20IP%20Paris.jpg?itok=E40Rs7jG)

The diversity of profile represented within Institut Polytechnique de Paris’ student community is one of its defining strengths. **For this reason, application procedures may differ depending on your personal situation, academic background, and the program you wish to join**. We strongly encourage you to verify, prior to submitting your application:

* the application platform that corresponds to your profile;
* the application deadlines and admission requirements.

## Applications platforms

**Please complete the form below to identify the application platform that best corresponds to your profile.**

The French National Master’s Degree is an internationally recognized degree awarded on behalf of the French State, distinct from non-national institution-specific degrees awarded independently by individual institutions.

### **Application dates via the IP Paris application portal**

* **1st session:** from October 29, 2025 to January 8, 2026
* **2nd session:** from January 9, 2026 to March 26, 2026
* **3rd session\*:** from March 27, 2026 to May 28, 2026

\* Please note: the following programs will not be open for the third session:

       M1 Cyber – Cybersecurity  
       M1 et M2 DataAI – Data and Artificial Intelligence  
       M1 et M2 CSN – Computer Science for Networks  
       M1 et M2 MiE – Master in Economics

For applications submitted via the national **MonMaster platform of the French Ministry of Higher Education and Research (MESR), applications will be open from February 17, 2026 to March 16, 2026**. For more information about their calendar, please visit their website by [clicking here](https://www.monmaster.gouv.fr/calendrier)

### **Prerequisites**

#### **Academic prerequisites**

* Admission to the **first year of a Master’s degree** is open to candidates holding (or in the process of obtaining) a Bachelor’s degree in the targeted field or a related discipline.
* Admission to the second year of a Master’s degree is reserved for candidates who have completed (or are in the process of completing) a first year of a Master’s degree.

General selection principles apply across all programs:

* **enrollment at a highly ranked university**, based on national rankings and/or the international QS rankings;
* **outstanding academic performance**, assessed according to the standards of the applicant’s home country and institution;
* **demonstrate an excellent academic background**, degree and a personal and professional project aligned with the chosen program.

#### **Language prerequisites**

* Applicants must demonstrate a strong level of English, generally B2 to C1, depending on the program applied for.
* A good level of French is also required for programs taught in French.

### **Application procedure**

Applications are submitted exclusively online and are file-based. Applicants will be required to provide the following documents:

* Degrees and academic transcripts;
* Two academic references (please note that it is the applicant’s responsibility to ensure that referees submit their references online);
* Curriculum Vitae (CV);
* Motivation letter;
* Additional specific documents may be required depending on the chosen program.

For further information, please consult the [FAQ](https://www.ip-paris.fr/education/masters/faq) or contact us at [master-admission@ip-paris.fr](mailto:master-admission@ip-paris.fr)

### **Application dates**

For the 2026–2027 academic year, the application period for the PhD Track Program runs from **October 14, 2025 to January 20, 2026, via the IP Paris online application platform**.

### **Prerequisites**

#### **Academic prerequisites**

* Admission to the PhD Track Program is open to candidates holding (or in the process of obtaining) a Bachelor’s degree awarded by an institution equivalent to Institut Polytechnique de Paris, in France or abroad.
* Students who have successfully completed the first year of a program equivalent to the PhD Track may, exceptionally, be admitted directly into the second year of the program.

General selection principles are applied toall programs:

* **enrollment at a highly ranked university**, based on national rankings and/or the international QS rankings;
* **outstanding academic performance**, assessed according to the standards of the applicant’s home country and institution;
* **demonstrate a strong interest in research**, an excellent academic record, and a personal and professional project aligned with the chosen program;

#### **Language prerequisites**

* Proof of English proficiency at B2 level is required (TOEIC, IELTS, TOEFL, Cambridge ESOL), excepted for native speakers and students who have previously completed a program taught in English.

### **Application procedure**

Applications are submitted exclusively online and are file-based. Applicants will be required to provide the following documents:

* Degrees and academic transcripts;
* Two academic references (please note that it is the applicant’s responsibility to ensure that referees submit their references online);
* Curriculum Vitae (CV);
* Motivation letter;
* Additional specific documents may be required depending on the chosen program.

For further information, please consult the [FAQ](https://www.ip-paris.fr/education/masters/faq) or contact us at [phd-track@ip-paris.fr](mailto:phd-track@ip-paris.fr).

Internationally recognized, a PhD represents a degree of excellence and a marker of very high expertise, opening doors to highly skilled positions in both the public and private sectors. IP Paris hosts two doctoral schools: **the IP Paris Doctoral School** and the **Hadamard Mathematics Doctoral School**.

### **Application dates**

Applications may be submitted at any time during the year.

### **Pathways for admission**

To be admitted to a PhD at the Institut Polytechnique de Paris, it is necessary to hold a master’s degree.

Two paths are possible:

* Apply online to the PhD thesis topics offered by the doctoral schools of Institut Polytechnique de Paris [by clicking here](https://www.ip-paris.fr/en/education/phd-programs) (see the Admissions tab on the PhD page);
* Develop, in consultation with a qualified researcher from one of the IP Paris laboratories, a thesis project and a funding application, then create an account on [ADUM](https://adum.fr/) for registration.

[MORE INFORMATION ABOUT OUR DOCTORAL PROGRAMS](https://www.ip-paris.fr/en/education/phd-programs)
